sloka: सीताम् प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम् ।सहाय मात्रेण मया राघवः स्वेन तेजसा ॥४-३६-७॥
transliteration: sītām prāpsyati dharmātmā vadhiṣyati ca rāvaṇam ।sahāya mātreṇa mayā rāghavaḥ svena tejasā ॥4-36-7॥

translations.english: 'Righteous Rama can merely restore Sita with my assistance. By his own fiery energy he will kill Ravana.
